summary: Một framework Spec-driven development cho AI coding assistants, giúp định cấu trúc PRD, lên kế hoạch và quản lý SDLC với context engineering.
usecases: AI assistants generate code based on structured specifications
Teams integrate SDD workflow into existing CI/CD pipelines
Context engineering for consistent AI coding behavior across projects
ideas: Combine with visual spec editors for non-technical stakeholders
Generate not just code but also test cases and documentation from specs
Create a marketplace of reusable specs for common AI coding patterns
